notes.title: Autonima Playtest Cinematics Update
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1609950/ss_0b6c80bef0d90e4dfa4e6eb1998fb4aa28336e7f.600x338.jpg?t=1632290935

Hi friends!

A new playtest build is up now. The playable story-line is three times longer, has new areas, new characters, new puzzles, and new cinematic animations!

It's also has some important performance improvements that should benefit the overall experience.

We finally have an actual TRAILER as well!

If you would like to get more development news you can follow @BaetylusGames on Twitter.

Or you can drop into the DISCORD and say 'hello'!

I hope you enjoy the update, and thank you for following along. :)

-Peter
